success.description: Your targets gain the Demoralised condition for 3 rounds.

boon.description: Your targets gain the Rattled condition for 3 rounds.

bane.description: Each enemy with Discipline trained adds {Dm} to the dice pool.

sigmarsComet.description: The duration of all conditions granted by this blessing is 5 rounds, not 3.

reckless.requirements: Flavour. Targets must be within close range and able to hear you speak. Special: This check is opposed by the highest Willpower amongst enemies within close range. Each enemy with Discipline trained adds {Dm} to the dice pool.
